policy_text: Eligible items may be returned within the product-specific return_window_days shown in the active catalogue. If the product has no return window, do not assume one.
Warranty coverage is only what the active product record states. 'No warranty stated' does not mean a warranty exists.
Only quote shipping information present in the active product record. Delivery estimates are estimates, not guarantees.
Use the active stock_status field. Do not promise availability for out-of-stock items or invent exact inventory.
Use price_inr as the listed price and mrp_inr as listed MRP. Do not claim a discount or final checkout price beyond the supplied fields.
If the active catalogue/policy does not support an answer, say: 'The catalogue doesn't specify this.' Do not guess.
Compare only fields available for both products. If a requested comparison field is missing for either item, state that limitation.
Customer feedback is not official product evidence and must not automatically overwrite catalogue facts. Owner review is required.
Rows marked SYNTHETIC_TEST_DATA are fixtures for software testing, not factual claims about real products, sellers, ratings, stock, or brands.
When answering a product-specific question, include the matching product ID as evidence if the app supports citations. Policy answers should cite the relevant policy ID.
